item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani attended on Friday evening the official state banquet hosted in his honour by German …
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani attended on Friday evening the official state banquet hosted in his honour by German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier at the Spreebogen presidential building in Berlin. In his speech, His Highness said the bond between the two countries goes beyond economic interests to a shared belief in dialogue, respect for international law and the peaceful settlement of disputes, and looked forward to expanding the partnership into technology, scientific research and advanced industries. The German President said their talks addressed ways to establish a new security framework in the Middle East that transcends the current escalation, and that they agreed to maintain close consultation on it. Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Bundestag President Julia Klöckner attended the banquet.

item.title: The Qatar Investment Authority and Brookfield announced a memorandum of understanding to explore investment opportunities in Germany's crit…
item.description:
The Qatar Investment Authority and Brookfield announced a memorandum of understanding to explore investment opportunities in Germany's critical industries and defence sector, with a combined target of EUR 15 billion. The QIA statement said Germany has identified defence among its priority critical industries, with a focus on domestic production capacity, technological sovereignty and resilience. QIA Chief Executive Mohammed bin Saif Al Sowaidi said the memorandum reflects the authority's commitment to long-term investment in strategically important sectors.

item.title: His Highness the Amir received at his Berlin residence on Friday Dr Hans Dieter Pötsch, Chairman of the Supervisory Board of Volkswagen Gro…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir received at his Berlin residence on Friday Dr Hans Dieter Pötsch, Chairman of the Supervisory Board of Volkswagen Group, and his delegation. They discussed areas of cooperation and prospects for their development, particularly in investment, in the presence of Chief of the Amiri Diwan Abdullah bin Mohammed Al Khulaifi and the QIA Chief Executive. A group spokesperson told Qatar News Agency that Qatar is a trusted long-term partner and that the continuity of its investment gives the company the stability it needs during the shift to electric mobility and software.

item.title: Day two of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 at Aspire produced 40 goals in eight matches: Italy swept Jamaica 6-0, Morocco opened with a …
item.description:
Day two of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 at Aspire produced 40 goals in eight matches: Italy swept Jamaica 6-0, Morocco opened with a 6-0 win over Fiji to top Group H, Spain and Belgium recorded convincing victories, and Côte d'Ivoire snatched a late 2-1 win over Uzbekistan. Qatar opened their campaign on Thursday with a late 2-0 win over Panama.

item.title: In round 10 of the Doha Bank Stars League, Qatar SC stunned 10-man Al Duhail with a late Ali Saoudi goal in the 90th minute, leaving Al Duh…
item.description:
In round 10 of the Doha Bank Stars League, Qatar SC stunned 10-man Al Duhail with a late Ali Saoudi goal in the 90th minute, leaving Al Duhail level on 21 points with leaders Al Sadd, who top the table on goal difference. On Thursday, Al Shamal snatched a 1-1 draw with Al Ahli through a Riyad Mahrez penalty in the 90+10th minute. Al Rayyan, also on 21 points, can reclaim top spot if they beat Al Shahania today, Saturday.

item.title: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh…
item.description:
The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen said it intercepted and destroyed three ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards Riyadh early on Saturday, after a Civil Defence alert at 1:53am; two explosions were heard in the capital before the alert was lifted. It was the second attack on Riyadh in days, after the Public Investment Fund tower was hit on Thursday. Early warnings were also issued in Al-Sulayyil and Najran, and the interception of a Houthi drone over the south of the Kingdom was announced later.

item.title: Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said on Friday evening that two ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards the Jazan reg…
item.description:
Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki said on Friday evening that two ballistic missiles fired by the Houthis towards the Jazan region were intercepted, with debris falling in Al-Shuqaiq. Saudi air defences thus intercepted five drones and three ballistic missiles on Friday, while the coalition struck one of the Houthis' main supply depots in Sanaa and the Houthis threatened Saudi Red Sea ports.

item.title: GCC states joined Oman in celebrating its 56th National Day, illuminating landmarks and buildings in the colours of the Omani flag in the U…
item.description:
GCC states joined Oman in celebrating its 56th National Day, illuminating landmarks and buildings in the colours of the Omani flag in the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Qatar. His Highness the Amir sent a cable of congratulations to Sultan Haitham bin Tarik, as did UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed; the UAE welcomed Omani visitors at border crossings with flowers, and Dubai's Global Village offered free entry to the first 4,000 Omani visitors.

item.title: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran has received no US response to its proposal, and that not moving uranium enriched to 60…
item.description:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran has received no US response to its proposal, and that not moving uranium enriched to 60% out of the country is a red line, while it remains open to a "fair solution" for the stockpile within a comprehensive agreement. He added that there is no objection to shortening the proposed timeframe for implementing the conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz from two days to one day or even two hours, stressing that the strait will reopen if Iran's demands are met and that the "neither war nor peace" situation must end.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/21/3081948 · WebIndia123 https://news.webindia123.com/news/Articles/World/20261121/4522537.html

item.title: The Cairo International Film Festival announced the international competition results at the close of its 47th edition, with a jury chaired…
item.description:
The Cairo International Film Festival announced the international competition results at the close of its 47th edition, with a jury chaired by Moroccan director Nabil Ayouch: the Golden Pyramid for best film ($7,000) went to Four Minus Three by Adrian Goiginger, whose lead Valerie Pachner won best actress and Robert Stadlober best supporting actor. Rudi Rosenberg won the Silver Pyramid for best director for Words of Love, Ashjan Al-Hams's Al-Baraniya took the Bronze Pyramid, and Leila Marrakchi and Delphine Agut won the Naguib Mahfouz award for best screenplay for The Strawberry.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/20/x/7626241 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=20112026&id=3efa904c-ecd0-49d0-aadd-a87b6568fe00

item.title: Gold kept falling in Egypt at the start of Saturday trading, with 21-carat dropping below EGP 5,500 to 5,475 (selling), 24-carat at about 6…
item.description:
Gold kept falling in Egypt at the start of Saturday trading, with 21-carat dropping below EGP 5,500 to 5,475 (selling), 24-carat at about 6,255 and the gold pound at 43,800. According to the Gold Observatory, 21-carat has lost about EGP 630 since the start of November, when it opened the month at 6,160, a fall of about 10.2%, as the ounce dropped globally to its lowest since September 2025.

item.title: Trading value on the Egyptian Exchange reached about EGP 652 billion during the week, against 596.7 billion the previous week, with 9,291 m…
item.description:
Trading value on the Egyptian Exchange reached about EGP 652 billion during the week, against 596.7 billion the previous week, with 9,291 million securities across 1,191 thousand transactions; bonds and bills accounted for 92.08% of the value. The EGX30 closed Thursday at 51,458 points, down 0.17%. Thunder led brokerages with EGP 21.961 billion in trades (25.6% of the total), followed by Al Ahly Pharos with 14.855 billion.

item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority forecast a continued slight rise in temperatures today, Saturday, with warm daytime weather and hot conditions in southern Upper Egypt, and highs of 27 to 28°C in Greater Cairo and the Delta. It warned of possibly dense fog from 4am to 9am on roads to and from the north, Greater Cairo, the Canal cities, central Sinai and northern Upper Egypt, with a 30% chance of light rain over Halayeb and Shalateen.

item.title: US President Donald Trump on Friday urged Nvidia to give its founder Jensen Huang a "second chance" and return him as CEO after a "big apol…
item.description:
US President Donald Trump on Friday urged Nvidia to give its founder Jensen Huang a "second chance" and return him as CEO after a "big apology", calling him "one of the truly most brilliant minds in the world". Huang resigned on 12 November following reports of a relationship with a woman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence, while the company's board said this week that it was moving on and did not intend to bring him back.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/trump-calls-for-nvidia-to-reinstate-brilliant-jensen-huang · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/future/technology/2026/11/20/trump-jensen-huang-nvidia-data-center-energy/

item.title: Denmark announced it is expelling Russia's defence attaché within seven days after Danish intelligence concluded that Moscow orchestrated a…
item.description:
Denmark announced it is expelling Russia's defence attaché within seven days after Danish intelligence concluded that Moscow orchestrated a plot to assassinate Ukrainian-American rapper Kyivstoner at a concert near Copenhagen with help from a banned local gang. Foreign Minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen said Denmark is also considering suspending Schengen visas for Russians, while Russia said there was no evidence.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/denmark-expels-russian-diplomat-over-alleged-plot-to-kill-ukrainian-rapper · Kyiv Post https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90775

item.title: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya went into overtime after its Friday deadline passed without a political deal, as nearly 200 countries r…
item.description:
The COP31 climate summit in Antalya went into overtime after its Friday deadline passed without a political deal, as nearly 200 countries remain split over a draft from which every mention of fossil fuels was removed after objections from Saudi Arabia and other producers, and which dropped a $120 billion adaptation finance target. The EU warned the summit risked becoming a "fossil summit", Panama threatened to walk out, and a third draft is expected today, Saturday.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/fossil-fuel-talks-deadlock-pushes-cop31-climate-summit-into-overtime · Free Malaysia Today (AFP) https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/highlight/2026/11/21/nations-row-over-fossil-fuels-as-cop31-goes-into-overtime

item.title: Poland accused Russia of "provocation" after its airspace was violated three times overnight by what were probably two missiles and a drone…
item.description:
Poland accused Russia of "provocation" after its airspace was violated three times overnight by what were probably two missiles and a drone, one of which landed in the south-eastern village of Nowy Lipowiec without casualties, as the "Coalition of the Willing" held exercises for a possible post-war mission in Ukraine. Warsaw said it would ask NATO for more support to secure the eastern flank, and Secretary-General Mark Rutte called the incident "clearly dangerous".
Sources: Al Jazeera English (AP, Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/poland-condemns-russian-provocation-after-airspace-violations · Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199977/world/europe/russia-strikes-ukraine-as-missiles-land-in-poland

item.title: Brent futures rose 59 cents (0.64%) to settle at $92.57 a barrel on Friday and US crude gained 77 cents (0.93%) to $83.98 on fears of renew…
item.description:
Brent futures rose 59 cents (0.64%) to settle at $92.57 a barrel on Friday and US crude gained 77 cents (0.93%) to $83.98 on fears of renewed regional escalation, but both benchmarks posted a third straight weekly loss amid expectations of a supply surplus. Brent has lost about a fifth of its value this month as Middle East supplies recovered, after the US Energy Secretary said flows through the Strait of Hormuz were at a record.
